section_summary.extract_value: This section presents a study by Pinto et al. (2017) investigating the mediating role of body appreciation and inflexible eating rules in the relationship between social safeness and disordered eating. The study involved 253 women, aged 18-50, who completed online self-report measures. Results indicated that social safeness significantly impacts eating psychopathology through body appreciation and inflexible eating rules.
